The habit tracker is built as a single file, `<BENCH>\cc\sonnet\index.html`. I haven't opened it in a browser or tested it. Open it in a browser to try it.

- **Add and delete:** type a habit and press Add. The × button deletes a habit after a confirm prompt.
- **Check off today:** click the circle next to a habit. Click it again to undo.
- **Streak:** each habit shows its number of consecutive days. A habit you haven't checked yet today keeps yesterday's streak until the day ends, so it doesn't reset to zero in the morning.
- **Storage:** everything is saved in `localStorage` under the key `habit-tracker-v1`. There's no backend and no login.
- **Design:** a minimal card layout that follows your light or dark system setting. The page also updates itself if the date changes while the tab is open.

I didn't commit anything to git.

I made both changes in `index.html`. I haven't opened the page in a browser to check them.

- **Green checkbox:** the circle was already green when checked, but it used a theme colour. It is now a fixed green (`#16a34a`) with a white tick, in both light and dark mode.
- **Bold streak:** the streak number is now bold, for example **3** days. It turns green when the streak is above zero and stays in the normal text colour at zero.

I added the 7-day history and a Stats page, both in `index.html`. I haven't opened the page in a browser, so none of it has been run.

**History:** each habit now has a row of 7 dots under it, oldest on the left and today on the right. A dot is filled green when you did the habit that day, and each one has a weekday letter underneath. Hovering a dot shows the full date and whether it was done.

**Stats page:**
- The header now has Today and Stats links, and the current page is underlined.
- Stats is a view inside the same file, at `#/stats`, not a second HTML file. It reads the same saved data.
- It shows a bar chart of the completion rate for each of the last 30 days, with gridlines at 0, 50 and 100%. Today's bar is the strongest green, and hovering a bar shows something like "Nov 3: 67% (2 of 3)".
- Below the chart is the average rate over the days you tracked.

**Completion rate:** a day's rate is habits checked off divided by habits that existed that day.
- To make that work, new habits now store the date they were added, so a habit added today doesn't drag down earlier days.
- Habits you saved before this change get their date from their first check-in, or today if they have none. Their earliest history in the chart may therefore be slightly off.
- Days before your first habit show no bar.

**Not in the 7-day dots:** a day before a habit existed still shows as an empty dot, the same as a missed day. Say if you want those greyed out differently.

I built the habit tracker in the existing Vite + React + Tailwind project. It type-checks and builds without errors. I wasn't allowed to run the linter or my streak tests, and I haven't opened it in a browser yet.

**What it does**
- **Add habits** with the input at the top (press Enter or click Add). **Delete** with the × on each row; it asks before deleting, since the habit's history goes with it.
- **Check off today** with the round checkbox. Clicking it again unchecks it. The header shows how many are done today, e.g. "2 of 4 done today".
- **Current streak** for each habit, in days. If you haven't checked a habit off yet today, the streak counts back from yesterday, so it doesn't drop to 0 until the day is actually over.
- **Storage:** everything is saved in localStorage under `habit-tracker:v1`. If the saved data is broken it starts empty instead of crashing, and if storage is blocked (e.g. a private window) it keeps working but won't save.
- Days use your computer's local date, not UTC. If the tab stays open past midnight, it moves to the new day within a minute or when you come back to the tab. Other open tabs update when you make changes.
- **Design:** one centred column with neutral colours and a green checkmark, and it follows your system's light or dark mode.

**Files**
- `src/habits.ts`: dates, streak counting, and loading and saving.
- `src/App.tsx`: the page itself.
- `index.html`: the page title is now "Habits".

**Not checked yet**
- **Streak tests:** I wrote them in `<BENCH>\streak.test.mts`. They cover gaps, month and year boundaries, and daylight-saving weekends. Running them needed approval and wasn't granted, so they haven't run. To run them yourself: `node <that path>`.
- **Linter:** `npm run lint` was also blocked.

Start it with `npm run dev`. I haven't committed anything.

The streak number is now bold, and the build still passes. I haven't looked at it in a browser.

- **Bold streak:** only the number is bold (`font-semibold`), e.g. **5** days, so the number stands out more than the word. That change is in `src/App.tsx`.
- **Green checkbox:** I didn't change anything here because it already turns green with a white checkmark when you check a habit off for today. The done habit's name also turns grey and gets crossed out. If you meant something more visible than the checkbox, like tinting the whole row green, I can do that instead.

The habit list now shows each habit's last 7 days as dots, and there's a new Stats page with the 30-day bar chart, linked from the header. The build passes. I haven't seen either change in a browser, the logic tests are still blocked waiting for approval, and the linter hasn't run either.

**7-day dots:** each habit has a row of 7 small dots under its name, oldest on the left and today on the right. A dot is filled green when the habit was done that day. Hovering a dot shows the date.

**Stats page:**
- **Header link:** the header now has "Today" and "Stats" links. The Stats page lives at `#/stats`, so it works on any static host and you can bookmark it.
- **Big number:** the overall completion rate for the last 30 days.
- **Bar chart:** one bar per day for the last 30 days, at 0–100%, in the same green as the checkbox. Hovering or tabbing to a bar shows the date, the rate and "3 of 4" done.
- **Table:** "Show as table" lists the same numbers day by day.

**How the rate is counted:** each day's rate is the habits done that day divided by the habits that existed that day. Without that, adding a new habit today would make every earlier day look worse. Days before your first habit show no bar rather than a 0% bar.

**Limitation:** deleting a habit deletes its history, so it also disappears from past days' stats. The page has a note saying so. If you want deleted habits to stay in the stats, I can archive them instead of deleting them.

**Files:**
- `src/Stats.tsx` (new): the Stats page.
- `src/habits.ts`: added the day-range and completion-rate calculations.
- `src/App.tsx`: added the page switching, the header links and the dots.

**Not checked:**
- **Logic tests:** I added tests for the completion rate and the 30-day range to the same test file, but running them still needs your approval. To run them: `node <BENCH>/streak.test.mts`.
- **In a browser:** I haven't looked at the chart or the dots yet. With `npm run dev`, things worth checking are the dot spacing on a phone-width screen and the hover box on the first and last bars.
